notes: The two decisions taken on the last report. An album whose title differs from yours by one trailing tag that says something — "(Live)", a venue, a date — is no longer refused outright: it goes to the album's own TRACK LISTING, which decides it. 634 of the 1,443 near-misses in two real reports are that shape. It needs 'check the track listing' turned ON; with it off nothing changed and a live tag never passes on a title alone. Five edition words added too — bonus edition, collector's edition, international version, U.S. version and the re-master spellings — while extended version, remixes, DJ mix, acoustic, Vol. 2 and EP were deliberately refused as different recordings.
